chapter: Kid Thomas band and dance work
title: Elton, Kid Thomas's first banjoist, and how Bocage joined
summary: Elton came with Thomas from the west and played banjo, then switched to sax, which opened the spot for Bocage.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: You had Elton with you there? Huh? You had Elton with you, you said?
He played, he played, he played sax.
I thought you said you had somebody named Elton. Elton.
Elton used to play. You mean Elton? Yeah. Elton played, Elton played Boundary over Thomas before I started playing. Oh I see.
And he was there that night you didn't make a nickel?

No he wasn't there. No he wasn't there. Elton wasn't there. No, Elton played Boundary over Thomas before I started, because him and Thomas came down here together. Thomas come from up around Los Angeles there somewhere, him and Elton. And they came down here and formed the band down here. Oh I see. Well after Elton start taking up saxophone with uh Professor Madata, well he stopped playing Boundary. Uh huh. And that's where I sat fooling with Thomas.
But Elton didn't play in those sites long. He played awhile and then he quit altogether himself.
